verdict.rationale: Per-institution health is a fair question for a financial-data aggregator like MX, but the evidence pack never documents institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, or error codes that separate institution-side failures from integration-side ones. User lookup of an individual end user's connection attempts and generic webhooks are adjacent features. They are not per-institution health reporting, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem
